pairs.question: Domine quis habitabit in tabernaculo tuo aut quis requiescet in monte sancto tuo?
pairs.answer: Qui ingreditur sine macula et operatur iustitiam.
pairs.derivation: Liturgical entrance question (v.1) answered by v.2. The question is the interrogative clause following the verbatim setup 'Domine'; the leading scaffolding 'psalmus David' (a title/heading inside v.1) is dropped as it narrates, not utters. Answer ends at the first full stop (v.2); v.3 'qui loquitur veritatem...' continues the catalogue of qualifications (elaboration), so it is cut.

pairs.question: Quis ascendit in montem Domini aut quis stabit in loco sancto eius?
pairs.answer: Innocens manibus et mundo corde qui non accepit in vano animam suam nec iuravit in dolo proximo suo.
pairs.derivation: Question v.3 answered by v.4. Verse numbers and the 'psalmus David prima sabbati' heading are stripped scaffolding. Answer is the whole of v.4 (one clause to the full stop); v.5 'hic accipiet benedictionem...' turns to consequence/blessing, so it is cut.

pairs.question: Quis est iste rex gloriae?
pairs.answer: Dominus fortis et potens Dominus potens in proelio.
pairs.derivation: Self-contained liturgical question-and-answer within v.8. The interrogative and its responsive answer sit in the same verse; verse number stripped. Stopped before the repeated antiphon 'adtollite portas' (v.9), which is a fresh utterance, not part of the answer.

pairs.question: Quis est iste rex gloriae?
pairs.answer: Dominus virtutum ipse est rex gloriae.
pairs.derivation: Second, distinct instance of the antiphonal question (v.10) with a different answer ('Dominus virtutum...') than v.8. Trailing 'diapsalma' is a stripped liturgical/scaffolding marker, not part of the answer.

pairs.question: Quis est homo qui timet Dominum?
pairs.answer: Legem statuet ei in via quam elegit.
pairs.derivation: Question (v.12) answered by what God does for such a man (rest of v.12 into v.13). Answer cut at the first full stop; v.13 'anima eius in bonis demorabitur...' elaborates the resulting blessing, so it is excluded.

pairs.question: Quis est homo qui vult vitam cupit videre dies bonos?
pairs.answer: Prohibe linguam tuam a malo et labia tua ne loquantur dolum.
pairs.derivation: Question (v.13) answered by the imperative instruction (v.14). Verse numbers stripped. Answer ends at v.14's full stop; v.15 'deverte a malo et fac bonum...' continues the series of commands (elaboration), so it is cut.
